name: ballast-monorepo
description: Ballast — the open-source safety layer for Postgres schema migrations.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ballast/core -w @ballast/cli -w @ballast/db && npm run build -w @ballast/web -w @ballast/worker
scripts.build:lab: npm run build -w @productlab/engine && npm run build -w @productlab/web
scripts.dev:lab: npm run build -w @productlab/engine && npm run dev -w @productlab/web
